THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE RESOLUTION

NOVARA HUMAN SUPPORT

Care with
clear ownership.

01

ILLUSTRATIVE ESCALATIONDamaged delivery · Refund request
CUSTOMER

“My order arrived damaged. It was a gift.
I want a refund.”

AI → HUMAN

Order details, conversation and issue summary passed to the expert.

HUMAN EXPERT

“I’m sorry this arrived damaged, especially as it was a gift. I’ve reviewed your order. Could you share a photo so I can check the next step under our damage policy?”

1Review the evidence

Confirm the issue and policy eligibility.

2Route the decision

Request approval if outside agent authority.

3Own the follow-through

Confirm the approved action and keep the customer updated.

Example only. Refunds, replacements and other actions follow your policies, permissions and agreed support scope.

B2B example / Account access

THE SAME MODEL, BEYOND E-COMMERCE

Get the user unstuck.
Keep access decisions with the owner.

ILLUSTRATIVE SAAS SUPPORT REQUEST
“I can sign in, but I can’t access our reporting workspace.”
AI SUPPORT

Checks approved access guidance, collects the workspace reference and error message, and offers supported troubleshooting.

WHEN AN ACCESS CHANGE IS NEEDED

A human reviews the context and routes the permission request to the authorised workspace administrator.

01

Understand the blocker

Identify the affected workspace and the error, using only the necessary information.

02

Recognise the boundary

AI explains approved steps. It does not promise or grant permissions it cannot authorise.

03

Hand over with context

Pass the issue, attempted steps and requested outcome to the designated owner.

04

Confirm the next step

Keep the customer updated once the administrator has reviewed the request.

Illustrative workflow. Account verification, data access and permission changes follow the client’s approved process. Never request passwords or one-time codes.

Getting started / Onboarding

FROM DISCOVERY TO A CONTROLLED LAUNCH

A clear path to going live.

INDICATIVE PLANNING WINDOW2–3 weeks

For a standard setup, subject to readiness.

01Days 1–3

Scope & align

Confirm channels, query mix, volume, coverage and escalation rules.

Client inputs

Goals, recent query samples, team contacts and current workflow.

02Days 4–8

Prepare & connect

Organise approved knowledge, configure the workspace and scope record lookups.

Client inputs

FAQs, policies, product information and approved system access.

03Days 9–12

Test & train

Test representative queries, handoffs and permissions; train the human team.

Client inputs

Review answers, confirm approvers and sign off the test cases.

04Days 13–15

Launch & refine

Start the agreed scope, monitor early conversations and address gaps.

Client inputs

A launch decision-maker and availability for initial feedback.

LAUNCH GATE

Approved knowledge → Tested handoffs → Confirmed coverage → Client sign-off

Planning estimate, not a delivery commitment. Timing is confirmed after discovery. Complex integrations, platform onboarding and delayed access or approvals can extend the schedule. Day ranges refer to working days.
